title: Won 1st of 45 teams at a global catalog hackathon
summary: Our four-person team won the catalog organization's 2016 hackathon with a way to use customer feedback on product pages to improve catalog data.
what_would_have_happened: Customer feedback on product detail pages went unused for catalog quality.
the_call: Use feedback customers already give to fix catalog data and route it back to contributors.
what_i_did: Built the entry with three colleagues.
what_changed: First place among 45 teams from six sites worldwide.

metrics.label: of 45 teams
metrics.context: teams from Seattle, Cupertino, New York, London, Bengaluru and Chennai
